projects.title: Portfolio
projects.tagline: This site: a full-stack MERN portfolio
projects.description: My personal portfolio built with React, Express and MongoDB, with a generative hero, scroll animations, dark mode, CV downloads and a working contact form.
projects.overview: Built for my MERN stack course, this portfolio goes beyond a static page. Content is served from a MongoDB database through an Express REST API, the contact form stores messages with Mongoose, and both CV formats are downloaded from backend routes.
highlights: Cursor-reactive generative canvas in the hero
Project filtering and sorting animated with GSAP Flip
Express API with validation, rate limiting and MongoDB storage
Dark and light themes, fully responsive

projects.title: Progress Tracker
projects.tagline: Habit, task and goal tracker with a REST API
projects.description: A productivity app for tracking daily habits, tasks and goals. It has a React frontend with Today, Habits, Tasks and Goals views, backed by an Express REST API and a MySQL database.
projects.overview: I planned Progress Tracker properly before writing code, with an app discovery and workflow design doc, a software requirements document and a build roadmap. The frontend is a React single-page app with bottom navigation between Today, Habits, Tasks and Goals. The backend is an Express API on MySQL with SQL migrations, supporting habits measured as yes/no, numbers, durations, pages or percentages, with daily logs.
highlights: REST API for habits: create, read, update, archive and delete
Normalised MySQL schema for users, categories, habits, logs and goals, run through migrations
Flexible tracking types: yes/no, number, duration, pages and percentage
Planned with workflow design, requirements and roadmap documents

projects.title: College Fest Management System
projects.tagline: Database-backed system for running college fests
projects.description: A DBMS project that streamlines college fest operations by managing event data, participant registrations and organiser workflows in one relational database.
projects.overview: Running fests with hundreds of participants showed me how messy spreadsheets get. This system models events, participants and organisers in a relational database so registrations and event data stay consistent and easy to query.
highlights: Relational schema for events, participants and registrations
Organiser workflows backed by SQL queries
Inspired by organising events with ~600 participants

projects.title: Boiler Drum Level Control
projects.tagline: Three-element PID control on a DCS
projects.description: A distributed control system (DCS) project implementing three-element PID control, with alarms and interlocks to keep the boiler drum level stable under changing load.
projects.overview: Drum level is one of the hardest loops in a boiler to control because of shrink and swell effects. A three-element strategy combines drum level, steam flow and feedwater flow so the controller reacts to load changes before the level drifts.
highlights: Stable drum level under variable load
